question: Who among the following is/was NOT a tabla player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sheikh Chinna Moula**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sheik Chinna Moulana popularly known as Sheik was a legendary **nadhaswaram player** in the Carnatic tradition. 
 
• He was awarded the Madras Music Academy's Sangeetha Kalanidhi in 1998.
 
• He was awarded the title of "Nadhaswara Acharya" by Vassar College, New York.
